easy_question: Never mind how well it is drawn. Does this picture show a bus stop timetable plate with clock times set out in rows by the hour? A realistic photo, a document mockup or an illustration ALL count as yes. Answer NO only if the image instead shows just a blank card that states an answer with none of that shown, or shows something unrelated. Answer yes or no only.

reference.q_row_hour: Copy the hour printed at the left-hand end of this cut-out. Write the two digits only.
reference.q_row_count: How many clock times are printed in this cut-out? Write the number only.
reference.q_total: This cut-out shows the foot of a printed plate. Copy the number of buses a day printed there -- the figure on the bottom line of the plate. Ignore every other number in this cut-out. Write the number only and nothing else.
reference.q_nine: Copy every minute figure printed in this cut-out, in the order they are printed, each written as two digits. Write numbers only.
reference.q_row_unit: Does this cut-out show one whole hour row of the timetable, rather than part of one? Answer yes or no only.

steps.target: an hour row of the timetable on the stop plate
the figure for the buses a day at the foot of the plate
the hour row of the timetable headed 09 on the stop plate
an hour row of the timetable on the stop plate
